children: RNS Number : 2524V  Commonwealth Bank of Australia  17 September 2026

In accordance with PRM 1.5.2R of the Prospectus Rules: Admission to Trading on a Regulated Market sourcebook, Commonwealth Bank of Australia (Legal Entity Identifier (LEI): MSFSBD3QN1GSN7Q6C537) announces that the following securities (the Notes) have been admitted to the Official List of the Financial Conduct Authority and admitted to trading on the main market of the London Stock Exchange plc on 17 September 2026:
GBP 500,000,000 Floating Rate Notes due September 2027 (ISIN: XS3508784835)
To view the Programme Circular dated 30 June 2026 relating to the Notes (the Programme Circular), please paste the following URL into the address bar of your browser.

Please note that the information contained in the Programme Circular may be addressed to and/or targeted at persons who are residents of particular countries (specified in the Programme Circular) only and is not intended for use and should not be relied upon by any person outside these countries and/or to whom the offer contained in the Programme Circular is not addressed.
